data.narrative:
Heven AeroTech, a Series B defense and security frontier-tech company founded by Bentzion Levinson, carries a current post-money valuation of $1.0B following $100M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis triangulates against a comparable universe of 10 firms spanning the Defense & Security sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and TurbineOne.

Two methods prove applicable to valuation synthesis. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier to the Series B post-money value, implying $1.9B. Peer-median analysis across five same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.2B, with peer valuations spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer cohort includes Dream Security at $3.0B and TurbineOne at $300M, establishing a wide but instructive range.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median estimate of $1.6B. The $1.1B–$1.6B band reflects peer-median anchoring, while upside to $2.2B reflects stage-progression momentum. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory relative to peer cohorts, customer concentration in defense contracting, and regulatory/export control exposure inherent to the sector.
